sudo -n bash -c 'set -ae; . /etc/lowcost-europa/lowcost-europa.env; set +a; cd /srv/lowcost-europa; export DJANGO_SETTINGS_MODULE=config.settings.production; runuser -u le001_1789265592 -- /srv/lowcost-europa/.venv/bin/python manage.py shell -c "$1"' bash "$1"

import json
from collections import defaultdict, Counter
from datetime import timedelta
from django.utils import timezone
from django.db.models import Count
from apps.catalog.models import Offer, OfferObservation, OfferCandidate, OfferFamilyPlacement, ProductFamily
from apps.catalog.services.public_eligibility import public_eligibility_q, is_ship_from_verified
from apps.catalog.services.weekly_discovery import WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS, PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY
now=timezone.now()
offers=list(Offer.objects.filter(public_eligibility_q()).distinct().only("id","ship_from_country","ship_from_verified_at","affiliate_promotion_status","is_active","owner_hidden"))
ids=[o.id for o in offers]
by_id={o.id:o for o in offers}
history=list(OfferObservation.objects.filter(offer_id__in=ids).order_by("offer_id","-observed_at","-id").only("offer_id","observed_at","availability","price","currency","delivery_days","search_delivery_days"))
latest={}
price={}
numeric=set()
for row in history:
    latest.setdefault(row.offer_id,row)
    if row.price is not None and (row.currency or "").strip(): price.setdefault(row.offer_id,row)
    if row.delivery_days is not None or row.search_delivery_days is not None: numeric.add(row.offer_id)
fam=defaultdict(set)
for p in OfferFamilyPlacement.objects.filter(offer_id__in=ids).values("offer_id","product_family__slug"): fam[p["product_family__slug"]].add(p["offer_id"])
out=[]
for slug in WEEKLY_FAMILY_SLUGS:
    subset=fam[slug]
    validorigin=sum(is_ship_from_verified(by_id[i],as_of=now) for i in subset)
    pending=OfferCandidate.objects.filter(product_family__slug=slug,status="PENDING").count()
    out.append({"family":slug,"public_eligible":len(subset),"origin_verified":validorigin,"origin_missing":len(subset)-validorigin,"last_stock_unknown":sum(latest.get(i) is None or latest[i].availability=="UNKNOWN" for i in subset),"numeric_delivery_ever":len(subset & numeric),"price_unconfirmed_24h":sum(i not in price or price[i].observed_at<now-timedelta(hours=24) for i in subset),"pending":pending,"new_discovery_paused":pending>=PENDING_CAP_PER_FAMILY})
print("REA_DEEP_CATALOG="+json.dumps({"utc":now.isoformat(),"total_offers":Offer.objects.count(),"public_eligible":len(offers),"public_by_family":out,"country_stored":dict(Counter((o.ship_from_country or "MISSING") for o in offers)),"recent_last_observation_count":sum(i in latest and latest[i].observed_at>=now-timedelta(hours=24) for i in ids),"retired_pending":OfferCandidate.objects.filter(status="PENDING",product_family__status="RETIRED").count()},sort_keys=True))

for p in apps/catalog/services/public_eligibility.py apps/catalog/services/weekly_discovery.py apps/storefront/views.py apps/catalog/services/observation_display.py; do echo "FILE=$p"; sudo -n -u le001_1789265592 git -C /srv/lowcost-europa ls-files --error-unmatch "$p" >/dev/null; done
cd /srv/lowcost-europa
grep -n -E 'is_ship_from_verified|public_eligibility_q|availability|price_observation|def offer_go|def publish_offer_to_storefront' apps/catalog/services/public_eligibility.py apps/storefront/views.py apps/catalog/services/owner_editorial.py | head -n 65
echo "REA_STATIC_END"
